description: This Swift source file defines an actor 'MicLevelMonitor' for monitoring microphone audio levels using AVAudioEngine, and a SwiftUI view 'MicLevelBar' for visualizing microphone levels as a segmented bar.

classes.name: MicLevelMonitor
classes.description: An actor that manages microphone audio level monitoring using AVAudioEngine, providing start and stop control and normalization of microphone input levels.

classes.name: MicLevelBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that visualizes microphone level as a segmented bar with color coding.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the audio engine, installs a tap on the input node, and begins capturing audio levels asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the audio engine and removes the tap, halting microphone level monitoring.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Updates smoothed microphone level and calls the update callback on the main thread.

methods.name: normalizedLevel
methods.description: Calculates a normalized decibel level from an AVAudioPCMBuffer.

methods.name: segmentColor
methods.description: Determines the color of a level segment based on its position in the bar.
